name: 陳雅玫
objective: This course is designed to equip students with the necessary English communication skills in the workplace. The content will include English resume writing, business English, English interviews, briefing skills, and office English conversation. This course will also strengthen students’ basic English skills, such as vocabulary, grammar, and writing.
課程進度(1-16週):
Week 1 Introduction 
Week 2 Online job search 
Week 3 Online job search
Week 4 Introductions & Interviews
Week 5 Introductions & Interviews
Week 6 Breaking the Ice 
Week 7 Breaking the Ice
Week 8 Mid-term Exam
Week 9  English Proficiency Test
Week 10 Writing Emails & Messages
Week 11 Writing Emails & Messages
Week 12 Answering Calls
Week 13 Answering Calls
Week 14 Organizing Meetings
Week 15 Organizing Meetings
Week 16 Final Exam
Weeks 17-18 Flexible Learning
彈性學習(17-18週):
類別
		  
		    ● 參與課程相關作業、作品、實驗、田野調查 (Participation in course-related assignments, works, experiments, or field research)
		  
      

      
        內容
        
          1. Week 17: Students are required to watch an instructional video recorded by the instructor titled "Guide to Producing a Job-Seeking Self-Introduction Video." The content explains the key points for producing a job-oriented self-introduction video.

2. Week 18: Students are required to complete the production of a personal self-introduction video (5 minutes) as an MP4 file.
        
      

      
        時數 (小時)
        
          4
        
      

      
        學習成果
        
          1. Week 17: Cross-check and record students' video viewing hours in the backend of NTUT's i-School PLUS platform, while simultaneously setting up a discussion board on Zuvio to guide interaction.

2. Week 18: Students submit their video MP4 file via the Padlet platform.
        
      

      
        評量比例
        
          Learning outcomes from the flexible week (s) account for 10% of the total grade.
